thread:
Avery (CEO): Quick pulse check from today's all-hands Q&A: ops asked for examples of why we win vs lose. Wanted to capture the top patterns and concrete follow-ups. I'll summarize and open for short clarifying q's.

Maya (Sales): Quick field notes: wins = predictable latency + transparent cost examples. Losses = SSO/KMS concerns, unclear private deployment docs, and vendor lock-in questions. Several buyers asked for a dedicated capacity SLA.

Priya (CS): On the customer success side: wins when we deliver a tight POC + Optimize suggestions. We lose when handoffs to their SREs lack runbooks and dashboards. Ops teams want sample alerts and thresholds.

Leo (SE): Technical asks that come up a lot: model pinning, deterministic evals, and small config snippets for rollouts. Adding a tiny config example usually fixes friction.

Jon (Eng): Engineering takeaway: biggest technical loss driver is intermittent long-tail latency during bursts. We're shipping KV-cache telemetry and per-request tracing to help root-cause.

Nora (Legal): From legal: customers ask for BYOK details and standard contract language around key custody. We should provide a short FAQ for reps.

Maya (Sales): Follow-up: what's ETA for BYOK/KMS? A few deals are paused on this.

Avery (CEO): BYOK/KMS prioritized for Dedicated/Private; targeting Q3 beta. Meanwhile, @Sam can you produce a 1-pager and an FAQ snippet for sales ASAP?

Sam (Product): Yep — will draft a 1-pager with KMS bullets, recommended contract verbiage, and a diagram. Posting in #product-resources by EOD tomorrow.

Priya (CS): Request: please add a "runbook + dashboard sample" to docs. Even a 1-page ops checklist helps retention.

Leo (SE): I'll add a 6-step POC checklist and attach runnable snippets to the SE kit.

Jon (Eng): For oncall: we'll start exposing request.trace_id in logs this week. If you paste trace ids in #eng-oncall, we can pull traces quickly.

Avery (CEO): Leadership asks: 1) approve a small docs/SE collateral sprint next month, 2) prioritize publishing SOC2 artifact pack and a public sales FAQ. I'll flag with finance and ops.

All-Hands Bot: Notes + action items -> https://notion.redwood/workspace/all-hands-1774009999

Maya (Sales): :thumbsup: This should shorten cycles.

Priya (CS): Can someone run a short report on lost deals by reason for the quarter? That helped prioritize last cycle.

Sam (Product): I'll pull that with @Maya and share by Friday.

Avery (CEO): Thanks everyone. If you have call excerpts or customer quotes, drop them on the Notion page. Closing thread.
